title: Risks from Climate Change for Water & Agriculture in Turkmenistan: Assessment Report on Climate Risk, Vulnerability, Gender and Vulnerable Groups
organization: HYDROPHIL / UNDP, for Ministry of Environmental Protection
temporal_coverage: Assessment November 2023–June 2024; climate comparisons 1991–2010 to 2041–2060; longer projections to 2099.
methodology: Stakeholder-informed impact chains and 29-model climate ensemble.
limitations: Selective assessment; conditional risks, not causal conflict estimates.

title: Independent Country Programme Evaluation: Turkmenistan
methodology: Document review, 116 informants and site observation; evaluation of 2021–2024 programming.
limitations: Contribution assessment, not experimental impact attribution; some beneficiaries were difficult to reach.

title: Local communities from Dashoguz and Akhal velayats discuss efficient water management practices as adaptation to climate change
organization: International Organization for Migration / UN Turkmenistan
temporal_coverage: Seminars in late April and mid-May 2025; publication 20 May 2025.
methodology: Official account of two-day local training seminars.
limitations: Reported activities and participant feedback, not evaluated resilience outcomes.

title: Protecting Turkmenistan's economic and social future from Climate Change: Insights from the Water-Agriculture Nexus in Dashoguz Province and Ashgabat City
organization: Robert Bierkandt and Sven Willner / UNDP
temporal_coverage: June 2024 synthesis of risks and proposed adaptations.
methodology: Policy synthesis of the 2024 water-agriculture risk assessment.
limitations: Derived from source 101; not independent replication or an implementation evaluation.
